rubrics.justification: Accurately notes limited image quality, broadly consistent full/expanded blastocyst appearance, compact ICM, and looser TE matching the reported 3AB/AB quality. Minor issue: image-based certainty is limited and the discussion leans on the lab grade more than direct visible features.
Comprehensively integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, PCOS, prior IVF/live birth, semen parameters, endometrium, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: good morphology and favorable uterine factors support transfer, while age-related aneuploidy appropriately limits prognosis. Probability estimate is well justified.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, avoiding routine add-ons, and cautious discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviation is some speculative discussion of stress/alcohol and fresh-cycle hormonal effects without provided hormone data.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, uterine reassessment, PGT-A discussion, and avoiding unproven add-ons.
